stories.title: Girl, seven, and aunt killed in fire police link to A66 crash deaths
new_facts: New house fire deaths (girl, 7, and aunt) near A66 crash site linked to case; two men, 23 and 31, in custody
Names victims Valentina Foster, 7, and aunt Natalie McDonald, 34; frames fire as gangland revenge murder linked to A66 crash
stories.line: A seven-year-old girl and her aunt died in a house fire that police suspect is linked to a deadly crash involving five youths and two officers.

stories.title: South Korea's central bank raises rates again, signals more hikes to strengthen currency
new_facts: Seoul stocks rose for a third straight day, driven by Nvidia's earnings report.
BOK governor calls the unprecedented back-to-back rate hike a strong signal to markets.
BOK governor says the won remains too weak against the dollar and needs to strengthen further.
BOK governor forecasts gradual rate hikes over the next six months.
BOK governor says the FX rate has stabilized significantly but remains elevated.
BOK governor calls for preemptive action to ensure macroeconomic stability.
stories.line: South Korea's central bank raises interest rates again and signals more hikes ahead to strengthen the weakening won.

stories.title: Nvidia buys Hugging Face as U.S. probes chip smuggling to China
new_facts: Nvidia reportedly agreed to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion.
US probing Singapore's Apex Logistics for smuggling Nvidia AI chip servers to China.
stories.line: Nvidia pursues Hugging Face acquisition while U.S. investigates smuggling of Nvidia chips to China through Singapore logistics firm.
